name: main street
description: the heart of downtown millbrook falls. a long stretch of historic brick storefronts — shuttered awnings, hand-painted signs, a few streetlights fighting off the dark. the sidewalk is cracked and buckled in places, worn smooth by decades of shoes. a single car sits parked by the curb, windows fogged. most of the shops are dark, but a couple still glow from inside. the air smells like old brick and cold night air, with a faint thread of coffee from somewhere up the block.
